accessibility.purpose: Explain how insulin helps glucose enter a body cell.
accessibility.audience: Adult learners with introductory health-science knowledge

alt_text.short: A diagram showing insulin helping glucose move from the bloodstream into a body cell.
alt_text.long: Bloodstream glucose is shown outside a body cell. Insulin binds to a receptor on the cell surface, which allows glucose to enter the cell and be used for energy.

diagram_structure.visual_hierarchy: title, key message, numbered steps, supporting labels

cognitive_accessibility.one_primary_message: Insulin enables cells to take up glucose.
